title: VentureAtlasForecast
description: A resolvable forecast question with timestamped submissions. Immutable history — revisions create new entries, not silent overwrites. Brier scoring applied after resolution.

question.description: A resolvable question. Good: 'Will at least 2 of 5 targeted buyers request a pilot by 2026-10-01?' Bad: 'Will this startup be good?'

resolutionType.description: Binary supports Brier scoring. Start simple.

resolutionCriteria.description: Objective criteria defined BEFORE resolution. Ambiguous hindsight resolution is a protocol violation.

deadline.description: No updates accepted after outcome is known. Closed at deadline.

conditionalOn.description: If this is a conditional forecast, state the condition clearly. Conditional and unconditional forecasts must never be merged accidentally.

referenceClass.description: Known base rate for similar events, if any. A 90% forecast where base rate is 10% requires strong evidence.

submissions.description: Ordered forecast submissions. Each new estimate creates a new entry — do not rewrite history.

informationAvailable.description: Context known at submission time — prevents hindsight bias.

resolution.description: Set only after outcome is objectively known. Requires source/receipt.

scoring.description: Computed after resolution. Policy: latest pre-resolution probability per forecaster.

naiveBaselineScore.description: Brier score of 50% naive forecast for comparison.

sampleSizeWarning.description: Auto-set when calibration view has < 10 resolved forecasts in a probability bin.
sampleSizeWarning.default: Calibration requires ≥10 resolved forecasts per bin before curves are meaningful.
